gaps.term: tape storage of the packed integer
gaps.quote: On tapes the integer is stored as $r$ blocks, with carries chosen so that each block is a digit in $[0,B)$ and the sign sits at the top.
gaps.note: The cited claim gives the stored form, but the reader cannot reconcile 'digit in [0,B)' (nonnegative) with 'the sign sits at the top', and the page does not say how the carries produce this form.

gaps.quote: each coefficient is the centered residue of what remains
gaps.note: This cited claim stands in for how coefficient recovery works; the page does not state why h(B) is congruent to h_0 modulo B (the other terms are multiples of B), so the reader cannot check that the recovery procedure returns the coefficients.
The bound |h_j| <= r 2^{2p} < B/2 is said to hold because r < 2^p, but the page never states or derives r < 2^p, so the reader cannot check that the bound holds.
